criteria_location: Each of 11 procedure guidelines (66 pages total) repeats: Description and Scope, Clinical Indications (General Information + criteria), Contraindications, Exclusions, Selected References, Codes. Lumbar parts: disc arthroplasty pp.25-28, discectomy/foraminotomy/laminotomy pp.29-32, fusion/deformity pp.35-41, laminectomy pp.48-52. Shared definitions (conservative management, failure, severity, imaging) sit in the 'General Information' paragraph repeated at the top of every guideline.
procedures_covered: Lumbar fusion and deformity (scoliosis, kyphosis) with or without decompression
Lumbar laminectomy incl. synovial cyst, dorsal rhizotomy, tethered cord, biopsy/excision
Also in same file but not lumbar: cervical decompression, cervical disc arthroplasty, bone growth stimulation, vertebroplasty, BMP

logic.top_level: pathways (each procedure has a list of conditions; each condition has an ALL list, sometimes with nested EITHER/ANY)

k_of_n.quote: Conservative management must include ... physical therapy AND at least ONE complementary conservative treatment strategy.
ANY of the following (1-4) are present AND ALL 3 additional criteria are met
ANY of the following: Persistent back pain ...; Listhesis greater than 50% ...; Progressive postural deformity ...; Persistent functional impairment; Neurological symptoms

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Three separate lists per guideline: Contraindications (disc arthroplasty, laminectomy tethered cord), Exclusions ('Indications other than those addressed in this guideline are considered not medically necessary including, but not limited to'), and inline relative contraindications. Open-ended 'including, but not limited to'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Explicit: 'Initial disc herniation when ALL ...' versus 'Recurrent disc herniation when BOTH criteria are met: Requirements for initial herniation; Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative management'. Fusion: recurrent herniation needs 3 months since procedure + 12 weeks conservative care; 'Fusion for same-level disc herniation without instability may be considered following two (2) prior discectomies'. Staged fusions: 'not medically necessary for fusion involving fewer than three (3) levels'. General section defines repeat diagnostic and repeat therapeutic rules.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Radicular pain (radiculitis/radiculopathy) with significant functional impairment and/or or physical exam findings that correlate with radiculopathy
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Redline artifact 'and/or or' (an 'or' inserted next to 'and/or'); unclear whether pain, exam findings, or both required.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: EITHER of the following ... Progressive or severe neurologic deficits ... (conservative management requirement waived)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The EITHER branch carries an inline waiver of a sibling criterion (6 weeks conservative management listed later in the ALL list); a tree needs an 'unless' construct.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Neurogenic claudication (symptoms aggravated by standing/walking and/or alleviated by sitting/forward flexion) or radicular pain (VAS at least 4) with significant functional impairment
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Followed by two more bullets restating the aggravated/alleviated symptoms as separate required items, so the 'and/or' inside the first bullet is contradicted.
Redline: old '6' and new '12' both extracted; the History table confirms 12 months for stenosis. Similarly 'past 6 9 months' = 9 months for herniation.

extraction_hazards: Redline: insertions are blue underline, deletions red strikethrough but both survive as plain text ('6 9 months', '126 months', 'thise section', 'Tthere', 'are is'); the clean intent must be reconstructed from the History table
The 'General Information' block (conservative management, failure, severity, imaging) is repeated for every guideline, so 4 lumbar copies plus 7 other sections
Footnote markers 1 and 2 (superscripts) run into text ('analgesics2')
Page headers 'Spine Surgery' and footers '© 2024 Carelon ...' interrupt lists mid-bullet
Multi-topic file: cervical, bone stimulator, vertebroplasty, BMP share the same headings (Clinical Indications, Exclusions) so heading matching alone grabs the wrong section
Table of contents has dot leaders and page numbers that look like section content
'Also see Lumbar disc herniation in the Lumbar Laminectomy guideline' cross-references sibling sections
interesting_structures: Layered definitions: a document-wide definitions block that criteria call by name ('conservative management', 'failure', 'significant pain')
Specific-overrides-general rule stated in text: 'The specific requirements take precedence over any stated general requirement.'
Waiver embedded in a criterion: conservative-care requirement waived for progressive deficit or cauda equina / conus syndrome
Spinal stenosis fusion is ANY(1-4) AND ALL(3 additional) with footnotes defining instability
Procedure-adjacent logic: staged multi-session fusion rule counts levels
Soft recommendations (tobacco cessation, shared decision-making) that are not criteria

fit_to_tree.why: Highly regular all/any with explicit definitions, which suits a tree; but redline text corruption, document-level waivers and defaults, 'ideally' thresholds and repeated boilerplate need preprocessing.
